brand.notes: Enviro Appliances — Pakistani brand (JW Corp, est. 2015, Lahore; Kalma Tower office). AC lines: wall splits (Titan, Iceberg, Classic, Alpha, Eco, Marvel, Thunder/TQ, Glacier, ACE, A-Cool, H-Cool, TQ Grande) + floor standing (Ultimate+, TG Grande/Plus, DX Galaxy/Plus). DOCUMENTED GAP as of 2026-09-23: no official fault-code table or service manual found (user-manuals page JS-empty). Exactly one verified code: E9 = refrigerant leakage detection (official product pages + 8+ PK retailers — confidence high). Generic OEM E/F/P tables exist for sibling platforms but were NOT imported (Enviro-unverified). E9 is a cross-brand divergence trap — other brands map E9 to different faults. Support: (042) 111-88-44-22, +92 320 0845120, info@enviro.com.pk. See docs/sources/enviro.md.
